//! The string-free core of the script interpreter (plan P26): which fiber
//! waits on which effect, which `Parallel` is running how many branches,
//! which fibers are done. The interpreter asks [`next`] what a fiber does,
//! and records every scheduling event with [`apply`]; the steps, results
//! and variables stay in the interpreter. Verus proves that [`apply`] keeps
//! [`invariant`] and that [`next`] only proposes what [`apply`] admits.
use suite_bridge_core::MAX_IN_FLIGHT;
use vstd::prelude::*;

verus! {

/// The most fibers a script has: the script and every `Parallel` branch it
/// launches. More is `Reject::Overflow`.
pub const MAX_FIBERS: usize = 32;

/// A `Parallel` in progress on fiber 0.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Join {
    /// At most this many branches at once, `1..=MAX_IN_FLIGHT`.
    pub max: u8,
    /// Branches not started yet.
    pub pending: u16,
    /// Branches started and not done.
    pub running: u8,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Slot {
    /// `Some(0)` for a branch; `None` for the script.
    pub parent: Option<u8>,
    /// The command whose effect the fiber waits for.
    pub awaiting: Option<u32>,
    pub join: Option<Join>,
    pub done: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Sched<const F: usize> {
    pub fibers: [Slot; F],
    /// Fibers in use: `fibers[..len]`.
    pub len: u8,
    /// The command number the next request gets; effect IDs are unique
    /// because it only grows.
    pub next_command: u32,
}

/// A scheduling event: what the interpreter's events do to the core.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Ev {
    /// The fiber requested an effect, numbered `next_command`.
    Requested { fiber: u8 },
    Answered { fiber: u8 },
    /// Fiber 0 started a `Parallel` of `branches` branches.
    Forked { fiber: u8, max: u8, branches: u16 },
    /// A pending branch of the fiber's `Parallel` started as a new fiber.
    Launched { parent: u8 },
    Joined { fiber: u8 },
    FiberDone { fiber: u8 },
}

/// What a fiber does next.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Action {
    /// Nothing until a result arrives or a branch finishes.
    Blocked,
    /// Start a pending branch (`Ev::Launched`).
    Launch,
    /// Every branch finished (`Ev::Joined`).
    Join,
    /// No steps left (`Ev::FiberDone`).
    Done,
    /// Run its next step.
    Step,
    /// A branch should start, but every fiber slot is taken.
    Full,
}

// ---- Specification ----
/// The empty slot: `Slot::default()`.
pub open spec fn empty_slot() -> Slot {
    Slot { parent: None, awaiting: None, join: None, done: false }
}

/// Branches among `fibers[1..k]` not done.
pub open spec fn live_upto<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, k: int) -> int
    decreases k,
{
    if k <= 1 {
        0
    } else {
        live_upto(s, k - 1) + if s.fibers[k - 1].done {
            0int
        } else {
            1int
        }
    }
}

/// Branches started and not done.
pub open spec fn live<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>) -> int {
    live_upto(s, s.len as int)
}

/// Fibers among `fibers[..k]` waiting on an effect.
pub open spec fn waiting_upto<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, k: int) -> int
    decreases k,
{
    if k <= 0 {
        0
    } else {
        waiting_upto(s, k - 1) + if s.fibers[k - 1].awaiting is Some {
            1int
        } else {
            0int
        }
    }
}

/// Effects awaited: `fibers.iter().filter(|f| f.awaiting.is_some()).count()`.
pub open spec fn waiting<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>) -> int {
    waiting_upto(s, F as int)
}

/// Slot `i` as the invariant requires it.
pub open spec fn slot_ok<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, i: int) -> bool {
    let f = s.fibers[i];
    if i >= s.len {
        f == empty_slot()
    } else {
        &&& if i == 0 {
            f.parent is None
        } else {
            f.parent == Some(0u8) && f.join is None
        }
        &&& !(f.done && (f.awaiting is Some || f.join is Some))
        &&& f.awaiting matches Some(c) ==> c < s.next_command
    }
}

/// No two fibers in use wait on the same command.
pub open spec fn unique<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>) -> bool {
    forall|i: int, j: int|
        #![trigger s.fibers[i], s.fibers[j]]
        0 <= i < j < s.len && s.fibers[i].awaiting is Some ==> s.fibers[j].awaiting
            != s.fibers[i].awaiting
}

/// What [`invariant`] computes.
pub open spec fn inv<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>) -> bool {
    &&& 1 <= s.len <= F <= MAX_FIBERS
    &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i < F ==> slot_ok(s, i)
    &&& unique(s)
    &&& match s.fibers[0].join {
        Some(j) => {
            &&& s.fibers[0].awaiting is None
            &&& 1 <= j.max <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT
            &&& j.running <= j.max
            &&& j.running == live(s)
        },
        None => live(s) == 0,
    }
}

/// Fiber `fiber` is in use and neither waiting nor joined nor done.
pub open spec fn idle_spec<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, fiber: u8) -> bool {
    &&& fiber < s.len
    &&& fiber < F
    &&& !s.fibers[fiber as int].done
    &&& s.fibers[fiber as int].awaiting is None
    &&& s.fibers[fiber as int].join is None
}

/// What [`next`] computes.
pub open spec fn next_spec<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, fiber: u8, has_step: bool) -> Action {
    if !(fiber < s.len && fiber < F) {
        Action::Blocked
    } else {
        let f = s.fibers[fiber as int];
        if f.done || f.awaiting is Some {
            Action::Blocked
        } else if let Some(j) = f.join {
            if j.running < j.max && j.pending > 0 {
                if s.len < F {
                    Action::Launch
                } else {
                    Action::Full
                }
            } else if j.running == 0 && j.pending == 0 {
                Action::Join
            } else {
                Action::Blocked
            }
        } else if has_step {
            Action::Step
        } else {
            Action::Done
        }
    }
}

/// When [`apply`] admits `ev`.
pub open spec fn admits<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, ev: Ev) -> bool {
    match ev {
        Ev::Requested { fiber } => idle_spec(s, fiber) && s.next_command < u32::MAX,
        Ev::Answered { fiber } => fiber < s.len && fiber < F
            && s.fibers[fiber as int].awaiting is Some,
        Ev::Forked { fiber, max, branches: _ } => {
            fiber == 0 && idle_spec(s, 0) && max != 0 && max <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT
        },
        Ev::Launched { parent } => {
            parent == 0 && next_spec(s, 0, false) == Action::Launch && s.len < F
        },
        Ev::Joined { fiber } => next_spec(s, fiber, false) == Action::Join,
        Ev::FiberDone { fiber } => idle_spec(s, fiber) && (fiber == 0 || (
        s.fibers[0].join matches Some(j) && j.running >= 1)),
    }
}

/// What `next` proposes, `apply` admits (a request, while command numbers
/// remain).
pub open spec fn proposes_admitted<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, fiber: u8, a: Action) -> bool {
    match a {
        Action::Launch => admits(s, Ev::Launched { parent: fiber }),
        Action::Join => admits(s, Ev::Joined { fiber }),
        Action::Done => admits(s, Ev::FiberDone { fiber }),
        Action::Step => s.next_command < u32::MAX ==> admits(s, Ev::Requested { fiber }),
        Action::Blocked | Action::Full => true,
    }
}

// ---- Lemmas ----
proof fn lemma_live_bounds<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, k: int)
    ensures
        0 <= live_upto(s, k),
        k >= 1 ==> live_upto(s, k) <= k - 1,
    decreases k,
{
    if k > 1 {
        lemma_live_bounds(s, k - 1);
    }
}

/// `live_upto` reads only `done`.
proof fn lemma_live_same<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, t: Sched<F>, k: int)
    requires
        k <= F,
        forall|i: int|
            #![trigger s.fibers[i]]
            #![trigger t.fibers[i]]
            1 <= i < k ==> s.fibers[i].done == t.fibers[i].done,
    ensures
        live_upto(s, k) == live_upto(t, k),
    decreases k,
{
    if k > 1 {
        lemma_live_same(s, t, k - 1);
    }
}

/// A branch not done is live.
proof fn lemma_live_pos<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, k: int, b: int)
    requires
        1 <= b < k,
        !s.fibers[b].done,
    ensures
        live_upto(s, k) >= 1,
    decreases k,
{
    lemma_live_bounds(s, k - 1);
    if b < k - 1 {
        lemma_live_pos(s, k - 1, b);
    }
}

/// Waiting fibers among `fibers[..k]`: fiber 0, and branches not done.
proof fn lemma_waiting_live<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, k: int)
    requires
        inv(s),
        1 <= k <= s.len,
    ensures
        waiting_upto(s, k) <= live_upto(s, k) + if s.fibers[0].awaiting is Some {
            1int
        } else {
            0int
        },
    decreases k,
{
    if k > 1 {
        lemma_waiting_live(s, k - 1);
        assert(slot_ok(s, k - 1));
    } else {
        assert(waiting_upto(s, 0) == 0);
    }
}

/// Slots past `len` wait on nothing.
proof fn lemma_waiting_tail<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, k: int)
    requires
        inv(s),
        s.len <= k <= F,
    ensures
        waiting_upto(s, k) == waiting_upto(s, s.len as int),
    decreases k,
{
    if k > s.len {
        lemma_waiting_tail(s, k - 1);
        assert(slot_ok(s, k - 1));
    }
}

/// With the invariant, at most `MAX_IN_FLIGHT` effects are awaited.
pub proof fn lemma_waiting_bounded<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>)
    requires
        inv(s),
    ensures
        waiting(s) <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
{
    lemma_waiting_live(s, s.len as int);
    lemma_waiting_tail(s, F as int);
}

/// One branch finishing: `live_upto` drops by one past it.
proof fn lemma_live_done<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, t: Sched<F>, k: int, b: int)
    requires
        k <= F,
        1 <= b,
        !s.fibers[b].done,
        t.fibers[b].done,
        forall|i: int|
            #![trigger s.fibers[i]]
            #![trigger t.fibers[i]]
            1 <= i < k && i != b ==> s.fibers[i].done == t.fibers[i].done,
    ensures
        live_upto(t, k) == live_upto(s, k) - if b < k {
            1int
        } else {
            0int
        },
    decreases k,
{
    if k > 1 {
        lemma_live_done(s, t, k - 1, b);
    }
}

/// `t` is `s` but for the slots `a` and `b`.
pub open spec fn same_but<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, t: Sched<F>, a: int, b: int) -> bool {
    forall|i: int| 0 <= i < F && i != a && i != b ==> #[trigger] t.fibers[i] == s.fibers[i]
}

// ---- One proof per event ----
proof fn requested_keeps_the_invariant<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, t: Sched<F>, fiber: u8)
    requires
        inv(s),
        idle_spec(s, fiber),
        t.len == s.len,
        t.next_command == s.next_command + 1,
        same_but(s, t, fiber as int, fiber as int),
        t.fibers[fiber as int] == (Slot {
            awaiting: Some(s.next_command),
            ..s.fibers[fiber as int]
        }),
    ensures
        inv(t),
{
    assert forall|i: int| 0 <= i < F implies slot_ok(t, i) by {
        assert(slot_ok(s, i));
    }
    assert forall|i: int, j: int|
        #![trigger t.fibers[i], t.fibers[j]]
        0 <= i < j < t.len && t.fibers[i].awaiting is Some implies t.fibers[j].awaiting
        != t.fibers[i].awaiting by {
        assert(slot_ok(s, i));
        assert(slot_ok(s, j));
    }
    lemma_live_same(s, t, t.len as int);
}

proof fn answered_keeps_the_invariant<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, t: Sched<F>, fiber: u8)
    requires
        inv(s),
        fiber < s.len,
        t.len == s.len,
        t.next_command == s.next_command,
        same_but(s, t, fiber as int, fiber as int),
        t.fibers[fiber as int] == (Slot { awaiting: None, ..s.fibers[fiber as int] }),
    ensures
        inv(t),
{
    assert forall|i: int| 0 <= i < F implies slot_ok(t, i) by {
        assert(slot_ok(s, i));
    }
    lemma_live_same(s, t, t.len as int);
}

proof fn forked_keeps_the_invariant<const F: usize>(
    s: Sched<F>,
    t: Sched<F>,
    max: u8,
    branches: u16,
)
    requires
        inv(s),
        idle_spec(s, 0),
        1 <= max <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT,
        t.len == s.len,
        t.next_command == s.next_command,
        same_but(s, t, 0, 0),
        t.fibers[0] == (Slot {
            join: Some(Join { max, pending: branches, running: 0 }),
            ..s.fibers[0]
        }),
    ensures
        inv(t),
{
    assert forall|i: int| 0 <= i < F implies slot_ok(t, i) by {
        assert(slot_ok(s, i));
    }
    lemma_live_same(s, t, t.len as int);
}

proof fn launched_keeps_the_invariant<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, t: Sched<F>, j: Join)
    requires
        inv(s),
        next_spec(s, 0, false) == Action::Launch,
        s.fibers[0].join == Some(j),
        t.len == s.len + 1,
        t.next_command == s.next_command,
        same_but(s, t, 0, s.len as int),
        t.fibers[0] == (Slot {
            join: Some(
                Join { pending: (j.pending - 1) as u16, running: (j.running + 1) as u8, ..j },
            ),
            ..s.fibers[0]
        }),
        t.fibers[s.len as int] == (Slot {
            parent: Some(0u8),
            awaiting: None,
            join: None,
            done: false,
        }),
    ensures
        inv(t),
{
    assert forall|i: int| 0 <= i < F implies slot_ok(t, i) by {
        assert(slot_ok(s, i));
    }
    assert forall|i: int, k: int|
        #![trigger t.fibers[i], t.fibers[k]]
        0 <= i < k < t.len && t.fibers[i].awaiting is Some implies t.fibers[k].awaiting
        != t.fibers[i].awaiting by {
        assert(slot_ok(s, i));
        assert(slot_ok(s, k));
    }
    lemma_live_same(s, t, s.len as int);
}

proof fn joined_keeps_the_invariant<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, t: Sched<F>, fiber: u8)
    requires
        inv(s),
        next_spec(s, fiber, false) == Action::Join,
        t.len == s.len,
        t.next_command == s.next_command,
        same_but(s, t, fiber as int, fiber as int),
        t.fibers[fiber as int] == (Slot { join: None, ..s.fibers[fiber as int] }),
    ensures
        inv(t),
{
    assert(slot_ok(s, fiber as int));
    assert forall|i: int| 0 <= i < F implies slot_ok(t, i) by {
        assert(slot_ok(s, i));
    }
    lemma_live_same(s, t, t.len as int);
}

proof fn fiber_done_keeps_the_invariant<const F: usize>(s: Sched<F>, t: Sched<F>, fiber: u8)
    requires
        inv(s),
        idle_spec(s, fiber),
        t.len == s.len,
        t.next_command == s.next_command,
        same_but(s, t, 0, fiber as int),
        t.fibers[fiber as int] == (Slot { done: true, ..s.fibers[fiber as int] }),
        fiber != 0 ==> (s.fibers[0].join matches Some(j) && j.running >= 1 && t.fibers[0] == (Slot {
            join: Some(Join { running: (j.running - 1) as u8, ..j }),
            ..s.fibers[0]
        })),
    ensures
        inv(t),
{
    assert forall|i: int| 0 <= i < F implies slot_ok(t, i) by {
        assert(slot_ok(s, i));
    }
    if fiber == 0 {
        lemma_live_same(s, t, t.len as int);
    } else {
        lemma_live_done(s, t, t.len as int, fiber as int);
    }
}

// ---- Code ----
// Not derived: a derived `Default` has no spec, and `Sched::default` and
// `apply` build slots with it.
#[allow(clippy::derivable_impls)]
impl Default for Slot {
    fn default() -> (r: Self)
        ensures
            r == empty_slot(),
    {
        Slot { parent: None, awaiting: None, join: None, done: false }
    }
}

impl<const F: usize> Default for Sched<F> {
    fn default() -> (r: Self)
        ensures
            1 <= F <= MAX_FIBERS ==> inv(r),
    {
        let mut fibers = [Slot::default();F];
        // The script itself.
        if let Some(first) = fibers.first_mut() {
            first.parent = None;
        }
        Sched { fibers, len: 1, next_command: 0 }
    }
}

fn slot<const F: usize>(s: &Sched<F>, fiber: u8) -> (r: Option<&Slot>)
    ensures
        match r {
            Some(f) => fiber < s.len && fiber < F && *f == s.fibers[fiber as int],
            None => !(fiber < s.len && fiber < F),
        },
{
    if fiber < s.len {
        s.fibers.get(usize::from(fiber))
    } else {
        None
    }
}

/// Branches started and not done.
fn live_branches<const F: usize>(s: &Sched<F>) -> (r: usize)
    ensures
        r == live_upto(
            *s,
            if s.len <= F {
                s.len as int
            } else {
                F as int
            },
        ),
{
    let mut n = 0;
    let end = usize::from(s.len).min(F);
    let mut i = 1;
    while i < end
        invariant
            end == if s.len <= F {
                s.len as int
            } else {
                F as int
            },
            1 <= i,
            i <= end || i == 1,
            n == live_upto(*s, i as int),
            n <= i,
        decreases end - i,
    {
        if !s.fibers[i].done {
            n += 1;
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    n
}

/// The invariant:
/// - `1 <= len <= F`; unused slots are empty;
/// - fiber 0 is the script, every other fiber a branch of it, and only
///   fiber 0 holds a `Parallel`;
/// - a waiting fiber waits on a command already numbered, and no two wait
///   on the same one;
/// - a done fiber waits on nothing and holds no `Parallel`;
/// - while a `Parallel` runs, fiber 0 waits on nothing, and `running`
///   counts the branches not done, within `max`; without one, every
///   branch is done.
#[must_use]
pub fn invariant<const F: usize>(s: &Sched<F>) -> (r: bool)
    ensures
        r == inv(*s),
{
    let len = usize::from(s.len);
    if len == 0 || len > F || F > MAX_FIBERS {
        return false;
    }
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < F
        invariant
            i <= F,
            len == s.len,
            1 <= len <= F <= MAX_FIBERS,
            forall|k: int| 0 <= k < i ==> slot_ok(*s, k),
            forall|a: int, b: int|
                #![trigger s.fibers[a], s.fibers[b]]
                0 <= a < i && a < b < len && s.fibers[a].awaiting is Some ==> s.fibers[b].awaiting
                    != s.fibers[a].awaiting,
        decreases F - i,
    {
        let f = &s.fibers[i];
        if i >= len {
            if !matches!(*f, Slot { parent: None, awaiting: None, join: None, done: false }) {
                assert(!slot_ok(*s, i as int));
                return false;
            }
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        let parent_ok = if i == 0 {
            f.parent.is_none()
        } else {
            f.parent == Some(0) && f.join.is_none()
        };
        if !parent_ok || (f.done && (f.awaiting.is_some() || f.join.is_some())) {
            assert(!slot_ok(*s, i as int));
            return false;
        }
        if let Some(c) = f.awaiting {
            if c >= s.next_command {
                assert(!slot_ok(*s, i as int));
                return false;
            }
            let mut j = i + 1;
            while j < len
                invariant
                    len == s.len,
                    len <= F,
                    i < len,
                    i < j <= len,
                    s.fibers[i as int].awaiting == Some(c),
                    forall|b: int|
                        #![trigger s.fibers[b]]
                        i < b < j ==> s.fibers[b].awaiting != Some(c),
                decreases len - j,
            {
                if s.fibers[j].awaiting == Some(c) {
                    assert(!unique(*s));
                    return false;
                }
                j += 1;
            }
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    let script = &s.fibers[0];
    match script.join {
        Some(j) => {
            script.awaiting.is_none() && j.max >= 1 && usize::from(j.max) <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT
                && j.running <= j.max && usize::from(j.running) == live_branches(s)
        },
        None => live_branches(s) == 0,
    }
}

/// What `fiber` does next; `has_step` says whether its queue holds a step.
#[must_use]
pub fn next<const F: usize>(s: &Sched<F>, fiber: u8, has_step: bool) -> (r: Action)
    ensures
        r == next_spec(*s, fiber, has_step),
        inv(*s) ==> proposes_admitted(*s, fiber, r),
{
    let Some(f) = slot(s, fiber) else {
        return Action::Blocked;
    };
    if f.done || f.awaiting.is_some() {
        return Action::Blocked;
    }
    if let Some(j) = f.join {
        proof {
            if inv(*s) {
                assert(slot_ok(*s, fiber as int));
            }
        }
        if j.running < j.max && j.pending > 0 {
            return if usize::from(s.len) < F {
                Action::Launch
            } else {
                Action::Full
            };
        }
        if j.running == 0 && j.pending == 0 {
            return Action::Join;
        }
        return Action::Blocked;
    }
    if has_step {
        Action::Step
    } else {
        proof {
            if inv(*s) && fiber != 0 {
                assert(slot_ok(*s, fiber as int));
                lemma_live_pos(*s, s.len as int, fiber as int);
            }
        }
        Action::Done
    }
}

/// The fiber waiting on `command`, if any.
#[must_use]
pub fn awaiting<const F: usize>(s: &Sched<F>, command: u32) -> (r: Option<u8>)
    ensures
        match r {
            Some(i) => i < s.len && i < F && s.fibers[i as int].awaiting == Some(command),
            None => forall|i: int|
                #![trigger s.fibers[i]]
                0 <= i < s.len && i < F ==> s.fibers[i].awaiting != Some(command),
        },
        inv(*s) ==> forall|fiber: u8|
            fiber < s.len && #[trigger] s.fibers[fiber as int].awaiting == Some(command) ==> r
                == Some(fiber),
{
    let mut i: u8 = 0;
    while i < s.len
        invariant
            i <= s.len,
            forall|k: int|
                #![trigger s.fibers[k]]
                0 <= k < i && k < F ==> s.fibers[k].awaiting != Some(command),
        decreases s.len - i,
    {
        if matches!(slot(s, i), Some(f) if f.awaiting == Some(command)) {
            return Some(i);
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    None
}

/// Whether fiber `fiber` may run a step now: neither waiting nor joined
/// nor done.
fn idle<const F: usize>(s: &Sched<F>, fiber: u8) -> (r: bool)
    ensures
        r == idle_spec(*s, fiber),
{
    match slot(s, fiber) {
        Some(f) => !f.done && f.awaiting.is_none() && f.join.is_none(),
        None => false,
    }
}

/// The state after `ev`; `None` when `ev` is not admissible here.
#[must_use]
pub fn apply<const F: usize>(mut s: Sched<F>, ev: Ev) -> (r: Option<Sched<F>>)
    requires
        F <= MAX_FIBERS,
    ensures
        r is Some <==> admits(s, ev),
        inv(s) ==> (r matches Some(t) ==> inv(t) && waiting(t) <= MAX_IN_FLIGHT),
{
    let ghost s0 = s;
    match ev {
        Ev::Requested { fiber } => {
            if !idle(&s, fiber) {
                return None;
            }
            let command = s.next_command;
            s.next_command = command.checked_add(1)?;
            s.fibers[usize::from(fiber)].awaiting = Some(command);
        },
        Ev::Answered { fiber } => {
            slot(&s, fiber)?.awaiting?;
            s.fibers[usize::from(fiber)].awaiting = None;
        },
        Ev::Forked { fiber, max, branches } => {
            if fiber != 0 || !idle(&s, 0) || max == 0 || usize::from(max) > MAX_IN_FLIGHT {
                return None;
            }
            s.fibers[0].join = Some(Join { max, pending: branches, running: 0 });
        },
        Ev::Launched { parent } => {
            let len = usize::from(s.len);
            if parent != 0 || !matches!(next(&s, 0, false), Action::Launch) || len >= F {
                return None;
            }
            let j = s.fibers[0].join.as_mut()?;
            j.pending -= 1;
            j.running += 1;
            s.fibers[len] = Slot { parent: Some(0), ..Slot::default() };
            s.len += 1;
        },
        Ev::Joined { fiber } => {
            if !matches!(next(&s, fiber, false), Action::Join) {
                return None;
            }
            s.fibers[usize::from(fiber)].join = None;
        },
        Ev::FiberDone { fiber } => {
            if !idle(&s, fiber) {
                return None;
            }
            s.fibers[usize::from(fiber)].done = true;
            if fiber != 0 {
                let j = s.fibers[0].join.as_mut()?;
                j.running = j.running.checked_sub(1)?;
            }
        },
    }
    proof {
        if inv(s0) {
            match ev {
                Ev::Requested { fiber } => requested_keeps_the_invariant(s0, s, fiber),
                Ev::Answered { fiber } => answered_keeps_the_invariant(s0, s, fiber),
                Ev::Forked { fiber: _, max, branches } => forked_keeps_the_invariant(
                    s0,
                    s,
                    max,
                    branches,
                ),
                Ev::Launched { parent: _ } => launched_keeps_the_invariant(
                    s0,
                    s,
                    s0.fibers[0].join->Some_0,
                ),
                Ev::Joined { fiber } => joined_keeps_the_invariant(s0, s, fiber),
                Ev::FiberDone { fiber } => fiber_done_keeps_the_invariant(s0, s, fiber),
            }
            lemma_waiting_bounded(s);
        }
    }
    Some(s)
}

} // verus!
